subject.title: fix(config): bound external catalog file reads with size limit

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally cap externally configured plugin catalog files at 16 MiB, warning and skipping larger catalogs rather than preserving their auto-enable metadata?
rationale: The implementation follows established bounded-read patterns, but it deliberately changes behavior for existing oversized catalog files and must be accepted as an upgrade boundary.

options.title: Approve the 16 MiB boundary
options.body: Accept the established bounded-metadata limit because oversized catalogs are warned about and later candidates continue to resolve.

options.title: Choose a different catalog contract
options.body: Set a different documented size limit or fallback behavior before merging if the catalog format has a supported legitimate size above 16 MiB.

recommendation.title: Approve the 16 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the established bounded-metadata limit because oversized catalogs are warned about and later candidates continue to resolve.
